scope: copyrev-m5 cancellation wording replacements require independent review

en:highlevel.titles.payments.invoice.voi.note: Pass. Cancel an invoice names the available action in ordinary words and clearly differs from Delete an invoice. It states a capability without technical void terminology, a dash, or a permission level headline.

de:highlevel.titles.payments.invoice.voi.note: Pass. Eine Rechnung stornieren uses the familiar German verb for cancelling an invoice. Rechnung matches the neighbouring invoice titles; stornieren remains distinct from löschen. It states the action directly without a dash or a permission level headline.

es:highlevel.titles.payments.invoice.voi.note: Pass. Cancelar una factura is a clear Spanish action phrase and preserves the English meaning. Factura matches the surrounding titles and cancelar differs from eliminar. The title contains no jargon, dash, or permission level headline.

fr:highlevel.titles.payments.invoice.voi.note: Pass. Annuler la facture plainly names cancellation in French and differs from Supprimer une facture. The definite article fits the single invoice being acted on. It states the available action without jargon, a dash, or a permission level headline.

hi:highlevel.titles.payments.invoice.voi.note: Pass. चालान को रद्द करें directly asks to cancel the invoice in familiar Hindi. चालान matches the neighbouring invoice titles and रद्द करें distinguishes cancellation from हटाएँ. It states the action without jargon, a dash, or a permission level headline.

ja:highlevel.titles.payments.invoice.voi.note: Pass. 請求書を取り消す plainly names cancelling the invoice in Japanese. 請求書 matches the surrounding invoice titles and 取り消す differs from 削除. The verb form remains clear as an action title and adds no jargon, dash, or permission level headline.

pt-br:highlevel.titles.payments.invoice..note: Pass. Cancelar uma fatura is natural Brazilian Portuguese for the action. Fatura matches the neighbouring invoice titles and cancelar remains distinct from excluir. The title states a capability without jargon, a dash, or a permission level headline.

zh:highlevel.titles.payments.invoice.voi.note: Pass. 取消账单 is a concise Chinese cancellation action. 账单 matches the catalogue invoice titles and 取消 differs from 删除. It preserves the intended action without adding jargon, a dash, or a permission level headline.
